scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env up -d --wait db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.test:scripts: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests && python3 scripts/ownership/pr_common_allow.py --self-test
scripts.contract:check: pnpm gen:api-types --check && pnpm --filter @jblog/backend openapi:generate && git diff --exit-code -- backend/openapi.json
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f backend/Dockerfile -t jblog-backend:local . && docker build -f frontend/Dockerfile -t jblog-frontend:local .
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:api-e2e && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm build:verify && pnpm contract:check
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm docker:build
